query.insertStudente: INSERT INTO studenti(email, password, nome, cognome, nascita, cid) VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?);
query.insertDocente: INSERT INTO docenti(email, password, nome, cognome) VALUES(?,?,?,?);
query.checkAmministratore: SELECT aid FROM amministratori WHERE email = ? and password = ?;
query.checkStudente: SELECT sid FROM studenti WHERE email = ? and password = ?;
query.checkDocente: SELECT did FROM docenti WHERE email = ? and password = ?;
query.getClassiByDocente: select c.* from classi as c join materie as m on c.cid = m.cid and m.did = ?;
query.getMateriaByClasseDocente: select materia from materie where cid = ? and did = ?;
query.getMaterieClasse: select m.materia from classi c join materie m on m.cid = c.cid where c.cid = ?;
query.insertVoto: insert into voti(voto, materia, data, did, sid) values(?,?,?,?,?);
query.getVotiByStudenteMateria: select * from voti where sid = ? and materia = ?;
query.deleteVoto: delete from voti where vid = ? limit 1;
